title_sq: Tek Komuna E Parisit, Prane Cristal Center Shitet Apartament 1+1 Ideal Per Investim !
description_sq: Tek Komuna e Parisit Prane Cristal Center Shitet Apartament 1+1 Ideal per Investim ! title_en: Near the Municipality of Paris, near Cristal Center, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in the Municipality of Paris, near Cristal Center, ideal for investment! The apartment is located on the 5th floor of a building with an elevator and is oriented to the South-West, which allows natural lighting throughout the day. The internal organization is as follows: entrance with corridor, living room with glass facade, a spacious bedroom, and toilet with window. The apartment has been recently restructured and is ready for furnishing. Positioning in an area with all necessary services and easily accessible makes this apartment ideal for investment. The apartment has full mortgage documentation.
